faults.why: عُطْلَة alone means 'day off' or 'holiday', not 'weekend' (which requires أُسْبُوعِيَّة or نِهَايَة الأُسْبُوع).
Both senses mean time off work or school; a single day off and a longer vacation are one sense in Arabic.
فِي البَحْرِ means 'in the sea'; 'by the sea' is عَلَى شَاطِئِ البَحْرِ.
